_howto: Guided setup for Employee Master (Demo / Setup mode). checks = what the data must show; confirm = the user confirms.
title: Set up Employee Master
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it. Each step checks itself against what you've set up.

steps.title: Departments
steps.why: Every employee belongs to a department. Departments drive who approves, which devices people are sent to, leave policies and reports. Set which department sits under which for your structure.

steps.title: Cost centres
steps.why: For financial reporting: which cost centre an employee's costs go to.
steps.todo: At least one active cost centre.

steps.title: Employee types and custom fields
steps.why: Your own employee types (beyond Permanent and Seasonal) and any extra fields you keep per employee, such as boot size or licence number.

steps.title: Payroll periods
steps.why: The cycles people are paid on. Every department (or person) must be on one.
steps.todo: At least one payroll period, with every active employee on one.

steps.title: Leave types
steps.why: The kinds of leave people can take. Their rules are set in ESS Master's Leave Policies.
steps.todo: At least one active leave type.

steps.title: Device access
steps.why: Which clocking devices each department is sent to. In demo nothing is sent to devices; after pushing, use Sync Device in live.
steps.todo: At least one department linked to an access zone.

steps.title: Managers
steps.why: Who manages whom: hierarchy levels, and a manager for each department or team.

steps.title: Teams
steps.why: Groups of employees across departments, for example a shift crew.

steps.title: Employees
steps.why: Create employees one by one, or bring them all in with the Import wizard. In demo they are for practice; when pushing, you choose employees one by one.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Create a test employee with every tab filled in.
  2. Open their profile: everything is there.
  3. Terminate them with a date, then reinstate them.
Test runs are never pushed to live.
